name: EtnProduct
fix_description: In addLiquidity, send LP tokens to the contract itself (address(this)) instead of msg.sender, preventing external callers from receiving free liquidity. Also consider adding access control to functions that trigger addLiquidity.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step exploit involving a flash loan, token swap, NFT/shop/product interactions, LP pair burn mechanics, and finally selling the manipulated token into a market contract. While the PoC is not very long, understanding why these protocol-specific steps inflate or unlock U value requires reading several custom contracts and DeFi flow assumptions, making it more than a trivial bug.
